title: model_aliases
description: One table per operation: stable names, engines and OpenAI-name patterns. A null target means the name exists and is not configured. Any lower-case operation id is accepted here; gateway/stable_aliases.py (OPERATIONS) lists the ids the gateway serves.

stable.description: Gateway names. A string points at a role, workflow, model id or another stable name. A list names engines in order (speech, transcriptions, rerank, decisions). Null means not configured.

engines.description: Engines by id: a service, an upstream model and the engine's own settings.

openai.description: Ordered patterns that map OpenAI model names to a stable name. The whole list is one entry.

voice_aliases.description: Voice names mapped to the voice an engine knows.
